provenance_timeline_interpretation.selection_snapshot_pinning: The current selection snapshot could not have been pinned before its generated-data commit existed.
provenance_timeline_interpretation.contract_authority: The preregistration contract becomes authoritative only when PR #18 is merged.
provenance_timeline_interpretation.future_merge_fact: The actual PR #18 merge commit and timestamp remain null until a later activation event records them.

candidate_designation.selection_snapshot_label: Current Backtest Qualified rank-1 candidate at the pinned selection snapshot
candidate_designation.selection_method: Selected by the Backtest ranking function src/backtest.py::rank_strategy_summary
candidate_designation.interpretation: The unique rank-1 result is evidence for choosing the proposed OOS candidate, not evidence that it is ready for live deployment.

parameter_fingerprint.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, and allow_nan=false

activation.description: PR #18 proposes the contract and immutable selection snapshot only. Genuine OOS eligibility begins with the first eligible ex-ante decision immutably recorded after a separately reviewed collector is activated.
activation.outcome_eligibility: An outcome is OOS-eligible only when it references an eligible post-activation ex-ante decision record.

evaluation_protocol.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, and allow_nan=false

correction_policy.description: Never edit or delete a recorded OOS observation. Append a correction record that identifies the superseded record, reason, corrected payload, source revision, and correction provenance.
correction_policy.effective_view: Derived metrics apply the latest valid correction chain while preserving every original and correction record.

frozen_semantic_definitions.classification: Definition-level inputs. A material semantic change requires a new cohort or an explicitly reviewed semantic migration.

semantic_fingerprint.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, and allow_nan=false

entry_rule.decision: signal is true for three consecutive trading sessions

exit_rule.event_ordering: existing stop, gap, open, intraday, and maximum-hold ordering

universe.construction: AUM-ranked Nasdaq Trader ETF candidates after configured name exclusions and manual overrides
universe.membership: daily realized membership under frozen eligibility rules

benchmark.date_alignment: exact economic-date equality without forward fill

src/backtest.py.role: strategy registry, ranking function, entry and exit rules, holding period, transaction costs, and historical feature construction

src/portfolio.py.role: canonical portfolio and benchmark economic semantics

src/universe.py.role: universe construction and base eligibility semantics

src/prices.py.role: price-adjustment convention and completed-daily-bar filtering semantics

immutable_candidate_selection_evidence.classification: Immutable historical evidence identifying why this candidate was selected at preregistration. Later Backtest runs and rank changes do not mutate or invalidate this cohort.
immutable_candidate_selection_evidence.selection_contract: The unique row with qualification_rank equal to 1 and qualification_tier equal to Qualified under the Backtest ranking function src/backtest.py::rank_strategy_summary at this pinned snapshot.

docs/data/backtest_summary.json.role: authoritative selected row, rank, qualification, resolved strategy identity, cost, and holding period

docs/data/backtest_strategy_summary.csv.role: tabular corroboration of the pinned selected row and rank

docs/data/backtest_portfolio_curve_manif.role: corroboration of the pinned strategy key in canonical portfolio publication

selected_row_fingerprint.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, and allow_nan=false

dynamic_observation_inputs.classification: Expected-to-change inputs. Content or blob changes alone are not frozen-definition drift.

config/aum.csv.classification: Dynamic AUM input captured for the pinned selection snapshot; not a permanently frozen semantic blob.

dynamic_observation_inputs.policy: Every future observation records the applicable input hashes and realized universe snapshot. Ordinary changes in these dynamic inputs do not mutate oos-0001.

operational_baselines.classification: Audited and versioned operational machinery. A file-blob change alone is not strategy-economic drift.
operational_baselines.compatibility_policy: The same cohort may continue after an operational change only when an explicit compatibility check confirms that all frozen semantics are unchanged.

.github/workflows/backtest-only.yml.role: Backtest Only scheduling and Backtest artifact ownership

src/run_daily_scan.py.role: scan-only Daily ETF Scan entry point

src/run_backtest_only.py.role: completed-bar filtering and Backtest Only calculation entry point

contract_merge_provenance.role: The later PR #18 contract merge identifies when this proposal entered main. It does not exist in this design-only branch and is not the calculation source or generated-data commit.

unresolved_items.description: The PR #18 contract merge commit and timestamp do not exist yet and must be recorded by a later activation event.
No append-only collector, activation mechanism, empty-ledger validation, or collector activation commit exists in this design-only PR.
No eligible ex-ante decision can exist until after collector activation; it must not be synthesized or backfilled.
